ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  CITY OF LA VERNE

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

 Tim Hepburn, Mayor  www.cityoflaverne.org
  (909) 596-8726 - Phone
 Muir Davis, Mayor Pro Tem
  (909) 596-8740 - Fax
 Robin Carder, Council Member
  City Hall Council Chamber
 Rick Crosby, Council Member
  3660 D Street
 Wendy M. Lau, Council Member
  La Verne, CA 91750

  Monday, November 01, 2021, at 6:00
  p.m. La Verne City Hall - Council
  Chambers, 3660 D Street, La Verne, CA
  91750

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s
Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st and
3rd Monday of every month.

The Council Chambers will be opened to the public. In an effort to keep a safe environment and to minimize
the spread of the COVID-19 Virus, the City will be limiting occupancy to invited guests only and masking will
be required for all in attendance. To facilitate public participation for those who do not wish to attend in
person, the meeting will still be made available virtually to residents. Provisions will be made for public viewing
with a sound system outside of the Council Chambers. Below are the following opportunities on how to
participate:

1)  View the meeting through the City’s website at www.cityoflaverne.org and click on the green
  “Council Meeting Live Stream” button.

2)  Individuals can email their comments to the Assistant City Clerk at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org up to
  noon on the day of the meeting. Those comments will be shared with City Council in advance of the
  City Council meeting and included as part of the permanent record. Please be advised that
  public comments submitted by emails or any other format to the City are public records
  that will be made available for public viewing.

3)  Individuals who wish to share their comments directly during the meeting may do so by emailing
  the Assistant City Clerk at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org with their phone number and the item(s)
  they wish to speak on. Requests will be accepted before and throughout the meeting and staff will
  call you back at the appropriate time. Once items are considered by the City Council, no further
  public comment on that matter will be accepted. A time limit of 3-minutes is set for all public
  comments.

4)  If  you  wish  to  participate  via  Zoom,  you  will  need  to  register  at
  https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_GKlF7zPwSAOhT2Lb9NX05A before 5:00 p.m. on the
  Monday, November 1, 2021, and please be aware that space is limited. You will have the ability to watch
  the meeting in real time and raise your hand to request to comment as appropriate on the current agenda
  item(s). Once it is your turn to speak, you will be brought into the meeting and have the ability to turn your
  video on when called upon.
 Agenda, Adjourned City Council Meeting, Monday, November 01, 2021, Page 2

1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

3.  ROLL CALL:  Council Member Lau, Council Member Crosby, Council Member Carder,
  Mayor Pro Tem Davis and Mayor Hepburn.

4.  Presentation to Families Recognizing Military Members (“Military Recognition Program“).
  La Verne has a total of 60 community members who are currently serving in our military. One
  individual will be recognized at this meeting. A mini banner will be given to the families of the
  individual being recognized.

  Army Specialist Thomas J. Lopez

 5.  Recognition of Boys Scouts for their Eagle Scout Projects in La Verne.

  Owen Arbogast is a senior at Bonita High School. He joined Troop 411 in Dec. 2014 and held the
  following leadership positions as he advanced in rank: Patrol Leader, Chaplain Aid, Quartermaster
  and Senior Patrol Leader. He has camped 83 nights and earned 38 merit badges. Owen’s Eagle
  project was designing and supervising the building of a mobile work station for Heritage Park. He
  used old wood and hardware so the work station would fit the time period of Heritage Park.
  Volunteers use the station for special events and during school field trips to the Park. In November,
  Owen will have his Eagle Board of Review and become an Eagle Scout.

  Joseph Harvey is a senior at San Dimas High School. He joined Troop 411 in January 2015 and
  held the following leadership positions as he advanced in rank: Patrol Leader, Librarian, Troop Guide,
  Assistant Senior Patrol Leader and Senior Patrol Leader. He has camped 82 nights and earned 26
  merit badges. His Eagle Project was planning and supervising the planting of roses and adding mulch
  along the west wall Veterans Hall and installation of a drop box where citizens can deposit old flags to
  be retired properly. Joseph will also have his Eagle Board of Review and become an Eagle Scout in
  November.

  Dallas Lopez is a senior at San Dimas High School. He joined Troop 411 in January 2015 and held
  the following leadership position as he advanced in rank: Den Chief, Patrol Leader, Troop Guide,
  Assistant Senior Patrol Leader and Senior Patrol Leader. Dallas has camped a total of 146 nights and
  earned 52 merit badges. His Eagle Project was planning and supervising the removal of grass, laying
  a concrete pad and then building and installing 2 picnic tables on the west side of Veterans Hall that
  can be used by Veterans as they wait for meetings or activities. Dallas had his Board of Review and
  became an Eagle Scout on July 13, 2021.

  Alex Sawabini is a freshman at Damien High School. He joined Troop 411 in February 2018 and has
  held the following leadership positions as he advanced in rank: Patrol Leader and Instructor. He has
  camped 20 nights and earned 33 merit badges. For his Eagle project Alex designed, planned and
  supervised the installation of a new sign on Wheeler Avenue for Heritage Park and the installation of
  lights on the sign. You can now see the sign at night. Alex had his Board of Review and became an
  Eagle Scout on July 14, 2021.
 Agenda, Adjourned City Council Meeting, Monday, November 1, 2021, Page 3

6. The La Verne City Council will recess to the La Verne City Council Meeting at 6:30 p.m.

  THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING of the La Verne City Council
  is on Monday, November 01 2021, at 6:30p.m.

  board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at cityoflaverne.org.
